items.headline: Cisco permitted for $15M second-floor office renovation
items.summary: A permit was issued for a $15,000,000 office tenant improvement on the second floor at 3098 Olsen Drive for Cisco.

items.headline: Five-unit townhouse building permitted on Seely Avenue
items.summary: A permit was issued for new construction of a 5-unit townhouse building (Lot 21) on Seely Avenue, valued at $1,841,161.
